slice: W216 bound ordinary JSON leaves at inferred Object Dynamic paths
status: VERIFIED within the finite declared scope
claim: Inferred Object Dynamic paths compose bound ordinary JSON leaves through the existing generic recursive visitor and Object child serializers, including normalized and finite Wide-part read/write/column/table consumers. No serializer is added per wrapper product.

admission.envelope: Root path values are bare BinaryValue actuals using the legacy DynamicValueCodec discriminator/arm envelope, not nominal BinaryDynamicBulkCodec.
admission.binding: Root path + canonical actual arm + descriptor-child position identify each JSON leaf. The roster derives a complete descriptor census under the borrowed operation budget, including unused arms. Missing, extra, duplicate, wrong-schema and whole-arm mismatches reject.
admission.origins: At an inferred-root JSON leaf depth D, child typed and inferred roots are D+1. Declared typed-Dynamic children retain typed D+1 and charge inferred D+2 only when their persisted Object metadata has inferred Dynamic paths; otherwise inferred D+1. The same budget crosses every handoff, without origin reset.
admission.domains: Parent physical P, child logical Q and deeper R/E occurrence counts remain distinct. P>0/Q=0 and terminal-zero schedules survive. Complete child domains/metadata validate before selected values and EOF; ordinary no-JSON selected reads retain their route.
admission.profile: Inferred-root JSON children inherit the parent Object shared-data profile; default single_stream. Typed-Dynamic child policy remains unchanged.
admission.grammar: Normalized admitted wrapper traversal reuses Array/Tuple/Map/Nullable owners. JSON-bearing Dynamic V3 ordinary rosters still refuse Variant-containing, recursive Dynamic and ordinary LowCardinality alternatives. Base-type availability is not arbitrary product admission.
admission.guards: Unbound public bulk constructors, ordinary child-stream JSON defaults, Dynamic SharedVariant defaults and outer Object shared MAP/Copy are not widened.
admission.physical_scope: Four finite Wide/LZ4 native cells per mode: single_stream/with_size_stream String profiles x BASIC/COMPACT Dynamic discriminators. COMPACT is not Compact MergeTree part layout.
